versions.changelog:
Initial release of the agent-brainstorm skill:

- Facilitates 4-hour subagent sync meetings for CyberLite coordination.
- Structured agenda covers Security Operations, Marketing & SEO, and Agent Performance domains.
- Includes a general brainstorming section for new ideas and improvements.
- Provides a standardized reporting format for summarizing action items, new ideas, pending issues, and next priorities.
- Emphasizes brief, focused meetings and immediately flagging urgent items.
